title: Advice suppression payload
description: Task-specific input payload used to decide whether candidate advice should be shown.

candidateAdvice.description: The candidate advice being evaluated for suppression.

actionId.description: Opaque identifier of the proposed action.

category.description: Task category that produced the candidate advice.

reasonCodes.description: Stable reasons supporting the candidate advice.

informationQuality.description: Overall quality of the information supporting the candidate.

stateChanged.description: Whether relevant game state changed since recent advice.
